about_the_game:
True Survival Horror – No Second Chances

Your objective is simple: survive long enough to reach the end of the road and escape the forest alive.

To do that, you must move from campsite to campsite, pushing deeper into increasingly dangerous territory while managing hunger, sleep, fuel, sanity, and resources. Every day is a calculated risk: explore new regions for better loot, or play it safe and conserve supplies. At night, visibility drops, monsters roam, and the Maintenance Man forces you forward — you can’t return to old camps, and you can’t outrun him forever. One wrong turn off a cliff, one poorly timed fight, one mismanaged resource, and your entire run is gone. You cannot turn back — the road only goes forward. Every stop is temporary. Every night is a test. Every decision determines whether your run continues or ends permanently.

Features

  • Looting & Crafting System –Scavenge abandoned camps, broken vehicles, and forgotten trails for materials to craft essential survival gear. Build weapons to defend yourself, reinforce armor to withstand attacks, and assemble camping equipment like tents, traps, and portable light sources. Every item crafted could mean the difference between surviving the night… or becoming part of the forest.

  • Open-World RV Exploration – Your RV is your only sanctuary. Drive freely across the vast forest, discover new regions, and use it as mobile storage and a temporary safe haven. Upgrade storage capacity, reinforce defenses, and customize it to support your survival strategy. But remember — safety is never permanent.

  • Dynamic Weather + Day/Night Cycle – Extremely Limited daylight offers a small window to gather supplies, hunt, and prepare. When darkness falls, visibility drops, creatures grow bolder, and paranoia sets in. The forest changes at night — new threats emerge, and familiar paths become deadly.

  • Permadeath with Persistence – Save during your run, but death resets everything. Lose your gear, your progress, and the path you carved through the forest. However, knowledge carries forward — each attempt reveals more about the world, its patterns, and the horrors stalking you.

  • Secrets of the Forest –Explore deep woods, hidden camps, cryptid lairs, and abandoned structures scattered across the map. Uncover environmental storytelling, disturbing clues, and the truth behind the man who stalks you through the night. Some secrets reward you. Others should never be found.

content_descriptors.notes:
Road Less Traveled contains horror-themed content including depictions of violence against humanoid enemies and creatures. Players may use weapons such as a wrench or limited firearms to defend themselves against hostile monsters and human cultists. Combat may include blood effects, injury animations, and enemy death sequences.

The game features intense horror elements including stalking, psychological tension, paranoia, and themes of isolation. Certain environments and narrative elements may depict disturbing imagery consistent with a mature horror experience.

The game does not contain sexual content, sexual assault, non-consensual acts, explicit nudity, or graphic torture. There are no depictions of drug or alcohol abuse. There is no player-performed self-harm.

This title is intended for mature audiences due to violence and sustained horror intensity.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1080 Ti or AMD RX 5700
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: Game does not require ray tracing.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-10700 or AMD Ryzen 7 5800H
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 or AMD RX 6700 XT
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
  • VR Support: Not supported

short_description: A horror camping open-world survival game where you drive from campsite to campsite, scavenge, craft gear, upgrade your RV, and manage hunger, fuel, sleep, and sanity to escape the forest alive. This is a permadeath game—if you die, you lose your progress and start over.
